_readme: PhantomPi Implant Configuration. Fill values below, then run: sudo bash setup.sh

network._comment: Interface roles and USB port paths. Defaults match standard PhantomPi wiring.

wireguard._comment: VPN tunnel to operator VPS. server_public_key, server_public_ip and server_port are REQUIRED. If implant_private_key is empty a new key pair is generated automatically.

keepalive._comment: WireGuard reachability monitor. server_ip is the VPN-side IP of the WG server.

lte._comment: Cellular modem settings. Set the APN for your SIM provider.

hotspot._comment: Emergency hidden WiFi AP. PSK must be at least 8 characters.

discord._comment: Webhook URLs for Discord notifications. Leave empty to disable.

sniffer._comment: Packet capture settings for inline traffic interception on eth2.
